class.name: RFDetrModel
class.brief_description: One-shot rf-detr object/keypoint detection over an RGBA image.
class.description: Wraps the rf-detr C ABI ([code skip-lint]rfdetr_model_load[/code] then [code skip-lint]rfdetr_detect[/code] then [code skip-lint]rfdetr_model_free[/code]) into a single method. See [RFDetrPipeline] for a residency variant that keeps the checkpoint loaded across [method detect] calls.

method.name: get_abi_version
method.description: Returns the rf-detr C ABI version this build links against.

method.name: get_status_string
method.description: Returns the human-readable name of an [code skip-lint]rfdetr_status[/code] enum value.

method.name: detect
method.description: Detect boxes in [param image_rgba] (size must equal [code skip-lint]width * height * 4[/code], RGBA row-major). Returns an [Array] of Dictionaries, each with keys [code skip-lint]x[/code], [code skip-lint]y[/code], [code skip-lint]width[/code], [code skip-lint]height[/code], [code skip-lint]score[/code], [code skip-lint]class_id[/code]. Empty on error; the reason is pushed through [method @GlobalScope.printerr]. Optional [param opts] keys: [code skip-lint]num_queries[/code], [code skip-lint]score_threshold[/code], [code skip-lint]max_boxes[/code] (default 512).
